glosses: Synonym of silky, like silk, silklike, particularly
Having a smooth, soft, or flowing utterance; attractive or (typically derogatory) convincing through pleasing expression.

examples.text: Taffeta phrases, silken terms precise, / Three-piled hyperboles, spruce affectation, / Figures pedantical; these summer-flies / Have blown me full of maggot ostentation:
